description: Use when you need to resolve an ENS name to an address, reverse-resolve an address to its ENS name, or read an ENS avatar and profile records. Do not use for registering or renewing names, or non-ENS naming such as Solana SNS. Returns JSON with an ENS lookup on Ethereum in one call: the address of a name, the verified primary name of an address (reverse), the avatar and text records such as url, twitter and github for 0.005 USDC per call. Typical response time 2000 ms (p95). Category: Data. Price: US$0.005 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

address.description: Ethereum address to reverse-resolve, e.g. 0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045 (send name or address, not both)

name.description: ENS name to resolve, e.g. vitalik.eth (send name or address, not both)

texts.description: Text record keys to read (avatar, url, description, com.twitter, com.github and email when omitted), e.g. ["url", "com.github"]

name: blackwood_ens_lookup
title: ENS name lookup
